value.summary: This pull request updates model configurations in `src/config/defaults.toml`, switching from a two-tier model setup (scan/deep) using different models to a single model for both tiers with a higher reasoning effort setting. The change appears to be a configuration update only, with no introduction of untrusted input handling, authentication/authorisation changes, network calls, deserialization, path traversal, secrets exposure, dependency changes, or CI permission changes. The diff modifies static configuration values and comments; no code logic is altered, and no dangerous sinks are introduced. The change is safe to merge from a security perspective.
